div.div: 5 تحبّك He bound, or tied, the حُبْكَة, i. e. the حُجْزَة: [see حُبْكَة, below:] (K:) or i. q. تَلَبَّبَ بِثِيَابِهِ [he raised, or tucked up, his clothes; or girded himself, and raised, or tucked up, his clothes; &c.]. (IDrd, K.) And تحبّكع بِنِطَاقِهَا She (a woman) bound, or tied, her نطاق [q. v.] upon her waist. (IDrd, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
